en: A pair of scissors combines two simple machines by using wedges for the sharp blades and levers for the handles.
Without sliding friction, the striking surface of a match would never get hot enough to ignite the phosphorus on the match head.
If you fell through a hypothetical tunnel drilled completely through the Earth, gravity would pull you to the center and then slow your fall.
The Earth's geographic North Pole is actually a magnetic south pole, which is why the north-seeking end of a compass needle points toward it.
Silver is the most electrically conductive natural element on the periodic table, but copper is used in wires because it is much cheaper.
A diamond sparkles brilliantly because its high refractive index traps light inside, causing it to bounce around internally before finally exiting.
Sound waves travel about four times faster in water than in air because liquid water molecules are packed much closer together.
Liquid water has a remarkably high specific heat capacity, allowing the ocean to absorb massive amounts of solar heat without rapidly changing temperature.
The food you eat contains chemical potential energy that your digestive system converts into kinetic energy for movement and thermal energy for body heat.
A sonic boom occurs when an object travels faster than the speed of sound, compressing the sound waves into a single shockwave.
A single static electricity spark can reach temperatures of thirty thousand degrees Celsius, which is actually hotter than the surface of the Sun.
Maglev trains use powerful electromagnets to levitate above the tracks, completely eliminating mechanical friction so they can travel at incredibly high speeds.
